row.team_price_text: Aha! Roadmaps Premium: $59/u/mo billed annually ($74 monthly)
row.evidence: Aha!'s SAML guide says the account "verifies the SAML assertion and provisions new users" but "Removing a user from your IDP will not remove them from your Aha! account"; no SCIM endpoint appears in the support sitemap or the API reference.
row.notes: New row; researched as Aha! Roadmaps, the main product (Premium $59, Enterprise $99, Enterprise+ $149 per user/mo billed annually; $74/$124 monthly; Enterprise+ annual only). SAML SSO is listed as built-in security with no plan asterisk (only IP control, antivirus and backup are Enterprise+), so sso_plan is Premium. Provisioning is SAML JIT only, with optional ProductPrefix/ProductRole attributes applied once at creation; IdP removal does not remove the user. The REST API (OAuth2 or per-user API key) can list, get, create (per product, optionally with an identity provider ID), update and disable users (enabled=false) and manage product roles and Enterprise+ custom roles; an Audits API exists. API plan gating is not stated. Okta's OIN 'Aha' app is SWA only; Entra's gallery app is SAML with JIT. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM page in support.aha.io/sitemap.xml (0 'scim' URLs among 2,731) or www.aha.io/sitemap.xml, and no SCIM resource in the API reference. SAML JIT is the only IdP-driven provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: Create a user in a product (optionally with identity_provider_id)
Update a user, including enabled (disable/enable) and administrator roles

audit_log_api.notes: Audits API returns record change history; whether it covers user/admin events is not stated.

rate_limits.text: 300 requests per minute and 20 per second, per account; 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: Custom roles are an Enterprise+ exclusive feature.

okta.notes: OIN 'Aha' app (last updated Dec. 16 2019) marks only SWA (page markup). Aha!'s own Okta guide uses a custom SAML app.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial: SP-initiated SSO and JIT provisioning; no provisioning tutorial (aha-provisioning-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Aha! publishes a Google Cloud Identity SSO guide; Google catalogue not checked.

onelogin.notes: Aha! publishes a OneLogin SSO guide; OneLogin connector page not loaded.
